Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

building — a structure with walls and a roof. Example: The building is old.
street — a road with houses or shops. Example: The streets are clean.
town — a place smaller than a city. Example: My town is small.
place — an area or location. Example: My favourite place is the square.
hospital — a place where ill people are treated. Example: There is a big hospital in the town.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There is a ... in the town.
• The building is old.
• It is in the town centre.
• My favourite place is ...
• There are services here.

Grammar focus: There is / There are for places in town.
Describe landmarks with there is and adjectives: There is a big hospital in the town. The building is old. Use place for an area or a location.
